title: ambulance-dispatch-forecasting
summary: A single-script project for forecasting ambulance dispatch demand, apparently for the Sindh region, that includes a commented-out data pipeline for generating synthetic ambulance records. The unexecuted code imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata to fit a model on cleaned ambulance data and produce 80,000 synthetic samples.
evidence: generate_sindh_synthetic_data.py:7-21, all lines commented out: '# from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer'
needs: All SDV usage lines are commented out (prefixed with #), so it's unverifiable whether this code was ever actually run; no README to confirm intent.
